name: @sderickson/hub-deploy
description: Platform deploy: the edge (Caddy), identity (Kratos) and hub. Products deploy separately from <product>/deploy.

scripts.prod-local: . ./env.remote && export CONTAINER_REGISTRY && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod-local.yaml up --detach --remove-orphans && saf-deploy register-sites --local && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod-local.yaml logs --follow --since 1m $(docker compose -f docker-compose.prod-local.yaml config --services | grep -v kratos-migrate)
